title: Strict config with defaults
hints: Fill a Config with the defaults first and then decode into it. Keys missing from the JSON leave those fields untouched.
json.Unmarshal ignores keys it doesn't know. To reject typos, use json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data)) and call DisallowUnknownFields() before Decode.
After decoding, check that Port is between 1 and 65535 and return an error if it isn't.
